title: Food Science and Technology
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Food Science and Technology Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify, evaluate, and apply food science principles to food safety, production, product development, and food systems management.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply scientific skills and research in the areas of microbiology, food science, and safety of food products during and after processing.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify and analyze the general processing flow for various food products including harvesting, processing, packaging, and storage.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to understand and differentiate various types of food production methods and demonstrate an awareness of chemical and physical changes that occur to food products due to processing.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify, explain, and compare laws and regulations governing food safety principles.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g. FDSTB1); these were matched to closed-list codes FDST B1-B4.
FDSTB5 (Food Processing Technology) and FDSTB10 (Food Systems Management) are required in the catalog but absent from the closed list; recorded as catalog additions.
